label: b53: ngu (NGU paper cell, beta_max 0.3), seed 1 of 8, 1.3M steps = 41.6M moves, 130k updates
notes: Batch b53, Group F row F1 (plans/algoExploration/f-ngu-agent57.md sections 0-3): Never Give Up (Badia et al. 2020) as the paper has it on this game, in one process on 32 lanes. R2D2's LSTM 512 core after fc 320 with the mixture one-hot, the previous action one-hot, the previous extrinsic reward and the previous intrinsic reward as cell inputs, dueling 512 streams, scalar Q; 32 mixtures, lane j on mixture j for the run (App. A read as j mod N), beta_0 = 0 .. beta_31 = 0.3 on the paper's sigmoid, gamma 0.997 (exploitative) down to 0.99 on the log interpolation; the Ape-X epsilon ladder 0.4^(1 + 8 i/31) PERMUTED over the lanes by a fixed seed so epsilon and beta are uncorrelated (review 3). Intrinsic reward r_i = episodic x clip(alpha, 1, 5): the episodic term Alg. 1 (k 10, kernel eps 1e-4, xi 8e-3, c 1e-3, s_m 8, per-lane memory 30,000 reset each episode) over a 32-d inverse-dynamics embedding of the BOARD (10x10x4 body/head/food/age, not the observation, whose history bits are the action), each lane acting on a snapshot of f from its episode start; alpha the RND (128/128) error normalised by its running mean and std. Reward r_e + beta_j r_i summed before the replay (CMR 0; a terminal row's r_i is 0). Transformed Retrace lambda 0.95 with mu stored per row, pi eps-soft 0.01 greedy on the online net, values on the target net, h eps 1e-3; windows 120 = 40 burn-in + 80 loss, stride 40, 5 lookahead rows; PER alpha 0.9, IS exponent 0, eta 1.0 (App. A); Adam 1e-4 eps 1e-4, target copy every 1,500 updates, clip 40; 6,250 windows and 20,000 rows before learning; the embedding (+ classifier, L2 1e-5) and the RND predictor trained on the last 5 pairs of each sampled window at Adam 5e-4. hist8, b2 reward, step penalty 0.01, shaping OFF (the paper-cell rule). a_{-1} random at each episode start (Agent57 App. E). THE BUDGET IS b52's UPDATE COUNT (the user, 2026-10-25): SNEK_REPLAY_RATIO 1/320 x 1.3M counted steps x 32 moves = 41.6M moves, 130,000 learner updates (86 target copies), against the paper's ~650k updates (5x short; three orders in frames). THE GROUP IS THE WALL-TIME EXCEPTION (the user, 2026-10-25). Benchmark 2026-10-25, laptop solo, 1 thread, idle: update 647 ms (1.25x b52's 517), collector 4.3 ms a 32-lane step at an empty memory and ~12 ms at a perfect game's 2,500 keys (the k-NN), aux passes 1.4 ms, Retrace 0.7 ms, ~2.5 GB peak RSS with the 30,000-window buffer resident (rows 2.4M x 305 B incl. the uint8 board) -- ~27 h solo. DESKTOP BENCH b99 (2026-10-25, four ngu arms with the stage-A workers up): 0.70 updates/s an arm (1.43 s an update), 6.7 counted steps/s, RSS 0.74 GB an arm at 18k windows (~1.5 GB full), 8.9 GB available -- so 30,000 windows and 4-arm waves stand, and the PROJECTION IS ~52 h a 4-arm wave, two waves ~4.3 days for the 8 arms. Two cells of 4 seeds: ngu (a-d, beta_max 0.3) and ngubeta0 (e-h, SNEK_NGU_BETA_MAX=0: every beta 0 and nothing else changed -- NGU's own R2D2 (Retrace) baseline; the gap between the cells is the intrinsic term's). Read: ngu against ngubeta0 for the intrinsic term; both against b52a-d for the series' cross-row reading, naming the estimator, target period, Adam eps, IS exponent, prefill, eta and alpha as what else moved. The exploitative mixture (0: beta 0, gamma 0.997) is what stage A and the passes measure; --policy-variant mixture:<i> measures another. Registered prediction (the agent, 2026-09-16): ngu trails b52 on onset and is level or below on density (the intrinsic term pays for board states the shortest route avoids, a high-beta lane wastes its episode); ngubeta0 is level with b52a-d within noise; the mean r_i trace falls early. A result that would matter: ngu ABOVE b52. Stage A every 1,000 counted steps = 32k moves, 1,300 evals an arm; each row carries ngu.intrinsic_mean, embed_acc, rnd_loss, memory_mean, updates_per_s and rss_gb.
